apps.name: 2FA
apps.summary: A two-factor code manager for TOTP and HOTP keys: scan or import from Google Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS, and Bitwarden, encrypted in KV, with backups to WebDAV, S3, OneDrive, or Google Drive.

apps.name: Agentic Inbox
apps.summary: A self-hosted email client with an AI agent that reads, searches, and drafts replies, on Email Routing, Durable Objects, R2, and Workers AI.

screenshots.alt: Agentic Inbox: Inbox with the agent

apps.name: Bark Worker
apps.summary: Your own push server for Bark, the iOS notification app: send notifications to your iPhone from scripts and services with a simple HTTP call, with devices stored in D1.

apps.name: BinThere
apps.summary: A zero-knowledge pastebin for one-time notes: encrypted in the browser with AES-256-GCM, burned on first read by a Durable Object, and gone after 24 hours.

apps.name: Bookshelf
apps.summary: A library for the ebooks you own: read EPUBs and PDFs in the browser or on a Kobo over OPDS, served from your own R2 bucket.

apps.name: CattoPic
apps.summary: A self-hosted image host: upload, tag, and browse images, with WebP and AVIF copies, expiry, and a public random-image API, on R2, D1, KV, Queues, and Cloudflare Images.

apps.name: ChatGPT Telegram Bot
apps.summary: Your own AI chat bot on Telegram, backed by OpenAI, Anthropic, Workers AI, or any OpenAI-compatible API.

screenshots.alt: ChatGPT Telegram Bot: A chat in telegram

apps.name: Cloudmark
apps.summary: Bookmarks without an account: create a collection with a write token, save pages with a bookmarklet or the Chrome extension, and open them from any device. On D1.

apps.name: CloudSSH
apps.summary: A web SSH terminal on Workers: connect to your servers from the browser with multiple sessions, SFTP file management, jump hosts, saved servers, and a bring-your-own-key AI assistant.

apps.name: Counterscale
apps.summary: Privacy-friendly web analytics you host yourself: a tracking script, a dashboard, and long-term rollups in R2, on Workers Analytics Engine.

apps.name: Cut
apps.summary: Self-hosted link shortener on Workers + KV.

apps.name: dgit
apps.summary: A git host on Durable Objects: push and clone over HTTPS with a stock git client and browse with a cgit-style web interface, one Durable Object per repository.

apps.name: FlareMo
apps.summary: A Memos-compatible notes app for quick capture: timeline, tags, attachments, semantic search, and an MCP server, on D1, R2, and Vectorize.

apps.name: Glance
apps.summary: Share what your coding agents build: publish HTML, Markdown and files as private sites your team opens, comments on, and annotates. An open-source alternative to Claude Artifacts.

apps.name: mail2telegram
apps.summary: Receive your domain's email in Telegram: a push for every message and a Mini App inbox with attachments, filters, and AI summaries.

apps.name: Mailflare
apps.summary: A self-hosted email service for your own domains: mailboxes, forwarding rules, and a web inbox, on Email Routing, D1, R2, Queues, and Durable Objects.

apps.name: Minvoice
apps.summary: Invoicing for one business: invoices with PDF attachments, pay links through Stripe and PayPal, payment reminders, reports and CSV export, on D1.

apps.name: NodeCrypt
apps.summary: End-to-end encrypted chat rooms in the browser: no accounts and no stored history, with private messages, images, and files, relayed by a Durable Object that never sees plaintext.

apps.name: NodeWarden
apps.summary: A Bitwarden-compatible password manager server: the official Bitwarden apps and browser extensions sync to it, with a web vault, attachments, Send, and passkey sign-in, on D1 and R2.

apps.name: Open Artifacts
apps.summary: Let coding agents publish HTML and Markdown pages to shareable links, with client-side password protection, version history, and updates in place when the project changes, on D1 and R2.

apps.name: OpenSEO
apps.summary: Self-hosted SEO research: keywords, rankings, backlinks and site audits, on your own Cloudflare account and behind Cloudflare Access.

apps.name: OpenAI Gemini
apps.summary: OpenAI-compatible API adapter for Gemini, on Workers.

apps.name: Pastebin Worker
apps.summary: A pastebin and file sharer with short links, syntax highlighting, rendered Markdown, client-side encryption, a URL shortener, and a curl-friendly API, on KV and R2.

apps.name: placeholders.dev
apps.summary: Placeholder images generated on the fly: SVGs of any size, text, font and colours, described entirely by the URL, with light and dark variants.

apps.name: Punctual
apps.summary: Scheduling links for you and your team, a Calendly alternative: booking pages, Google and Microsoft 365 calendar sync, round-robin and collective events, reminders, and webhooks.

apps.name: Quickinbox
apps.summary: Email for your own domain: a web mail client with threads, attachments, several users and domains, plus a REST API, CLI and MCP server.

apps.name: R2 Explorer
apps.summary: A Google Drive-like file browser for an R2 bucket, on Workers + R2.

apps.name: Second Brain
apps.summary: A personal memory for your AI assistants: an MCP server that stores notes in D1 and recalls them by meaning with Vectorize and Workers AI.

apps.name: ShareHTML
apps.summary: Publish HTML, Markdown, and code files from the command line and get a shareable link with live comments, reactions, and presence. Sign-in through Cloudflare Access.

apps.name: ShotSync
apps.summary: A private image and text pool shared across your devices: drop a screenshot or snippet on one, grab it on another, from an installable web app backed by R2.

apps.name: shrtnr
apps.summary: A URL shortener you drive from code and AI assistants: a REST API with typed SDKs, an MCP server, per-user links behind Cloudflare Access, bundles and click analytics, on D1 and KV.

apps.name: Sink
apps.summary: Link shortener with visit analytics: custom slugs, expiring links, QR codes, AI slug suggestions and a realtime globe, all on Cloudflare.

apps.name: Turborepo Remote Cache
apps.summary: A Turborepo remote cache server on Workers and R2: point turbo at it and share build outputs between your machines and CI, without Vercel.

apps.name: UniFi DDNS
apps.summary: Dynamic DNS for UniFi gateways: keeps Cloudflare A/AAAA records on your current IP.

apps.name: Usage Guard Collector
apps.summary: Usage surge alerts for your Cloudflare account: reads daily Workers, D1, Durable Objects, KV, R2 and Queues counts into D1 and pings Discord or Slack when a meter jumps.

apps.name: Workers Firecrawl
apps.summary: A Firecrawl-compatible search, scrape and map API on Browser Rendering: point the Firecrawl SDKs at your own Worker and get pages as Markdown, HTML, links or screenshots.

apps.name: YAOS
apps.summary: Real-time sync for Obsidian vaults: edits merge live across devices as CRDTs, with attachments and snapshots in R2, through a Worker you own.
